english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for accepting a claim, believing someone, or having confidence in someone.
Use this when expressing confidence that a proposition or situation is true.
Use it when accept means believing that something is true.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 nei5 gong2 ge3 je5

examples.english: I trust that he’ll come back tomorrow.

examples.english: I accept that what they said is true.
